project.name: 5 AI Influencer Character Sheet Set
project.reference_style_source: buyer uploaded lookbook sheet: two-frame composite, half-body front view plus full-body view, plain white seamless background, soft even studio lighting, natural makeup, photorealistic catalog quality
project.sheet_format: every character is generated as a two-frame character sheet: frame A half-body front facing camera, frame B full body standing straight, arms relaxed, looking directly at the lens

global_rules.photorealism: true photographic quality, real skin texture with pores and fine hairs, no illustration, no 3D render look, no over-smoothing
global_rules.background: plain white seamless studio background in every frame
global_rules.lighting: soft even studio lighting, minimal shadows, large softbox front fill plus subtle hair light, color accurate skin tones
global_rules.camera: shot on 85mm lens at f/5.6, catalog lookbook framing, high resolution, sharp focus on eyes
global_rules.consistency: each character keeps the same face, hair and features across every future generation, lock each one as a separate Soul ID

usage_pipeline.step_1: Generate each character sheet with the paste_ready prompt, verify frame A face detail and frame B body proportions before anything else
usage_pipeline.step_2: Upload each character's sheet as its own Soul ID in Higgsfield and let it lock for 3 to 5 minutes, one Soul ID per character, never mix them
usage_pipeline.step_3: Generate lane content per character: Maya covers makeup, Zara covers fashion and styling, Camila covers skincare and wellness, Imani covers hair and protective styles, Sofia covers nails and lifestyle
usage_pipeline.step_4: Animate the best still of each character with Kling or Genjutsu, keep motion strength medium so the face stays locked
usage_pipeline.step_5: Label every post as AI-generated per platform rules
verify_for_every_image: same face as the sheet in every frame
